settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Falcons and Buccaneers, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Falcons" if Falcons win the game.
This market will resolve to "Buccaneers" if Buccaneers win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Browns and Steelers, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Browns" if Browns win the game.
This market will resolve to "Steelers" if Steelers win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Colts and Jaguars, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Colts" if Colts win the game.
This market will resolve to "Jaguars" if Jaguars win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Vikings and Lions, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Vikings" if Vikings win the game.
This market will resolve to "Lions" if Lions win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Ravens and Bills, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Ravens" if Ravens win the game.
This market will resolve to "Bills" if Bills win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
